note: Central (or burning-zone) mass density rho [kg/m^3] and temperature T [K]; order-of-magnitude values for the rho-T widget. 'computed' entries come from derivations/chapters/ch03_stars.py.

objects.name: Sun, centre
objects.ref: Model S, Christensen-Dalsgaard et al., Science 272, 1286 (1996), doi:10.1126/science.272.5266.1286
objects.label: right

objects.name: White dwarf, 0.6 M☉, centre
objects.fusion: none: cooling ash (C, O); pycnonuclear only at much higher density
objects.ref: rho: our Chandrasekhar equation of state (computed); T: Fontaine, Brassard & Bergeron, PASP 113, 409 (2001), doi:10.1086/319535
objects.label: right

objects.name: Classical nova, envelope base at peak
objects.fusion: hot CNO runaway on accreted H; limited by β⁺ decays of ¹⁴O, ¹⁵O
objects.label: left

objects.name: X-ray burst on a neutron star
objects.fusion: He flash and rp process (rapid proton capture) up to Sn–Te
objects.ref: Schatz et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 86, 3471 (2001), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.86.3471
objects.label: left

objects.name: Type Ia supernova, carbon ignition
objects.fusion: ¹²C+¹²C runaway in degenerate matter: no thermostat
objects.label: right

objects.name: Type Ia supernova, burning front
objects.fusion: C, O → ⁵⁶Ni (about 0.6 M☉); ⁵⁶Ni → ⁵⁶Co → ⁵⁶Fe powers the light
objects.label: left

objects.name: Core collapse, bounce
objects.fusion: none: nuclear density, nuclei dissolved; gravity powers the explosion, neutrinos carry 99 %
objects.ref: Janka et al., Phys. Rep. 442, 38 (2007), doi:10.1016/j.physrep.2007.02.002
objects.label: left

objects.name: Accreting neutron-star crust
objects.fusion: pycnonuclear: zero-point motion in the lattice, density not temperature
objects.label: left

objects.name: Tokamak plasma (ITER design)
objects.ref: n = 1e20 m^-3 D-T, k_BT = 10 keV; ITER Physics Basis, Nucl. Fusion 39, 2137 (1999), doi:10.1088/0029-5515/39/12/301
objects.label: right

objects.name: Laser fusion hot spot (NIF)
objects.fusion: D–T, inertially confined for about 0.1 ns
objects.label: left
